directive: Correct the sole N-mischar finding before the next review. Rewrite every Zhang–Li–Miao–Tchetgen (2023) comparison in related_work, project_justification.gap/niche/fill, tldr, and theorem justifications to acknowledge that their nonunique-bridge estimator is root-n, regular, asymptotically linear, and locally semiparametrically efficient under additional regularity; delimit our new claim specifically to the joint observed-law model with simultaneous nonunique outcome- and treatment-bridge existence, its complete tangent/normal geometry, the affine-hull canonical gradient, and global efficiency across bridge pairs. Add an explicit theorem or corollary, tied to the exact positive rank-two witness, that names the Zhang/Bennett selected-pair comparator and proves its variance strictly exceeds the affine quotient bound on a positive regular chart under the comparator's actual assumptions. Keep score-lifting completeness as an explicit load-bearing open obligation for Stage 0; do not claim the projection or efficiency theorems unconditionally until that reverse tangent inclusion is proved. Preserve the existing fixed-rank/closed-range model and do not add uniqueness, surjectivity, a preferred bridge, or any crux-encoding assumption.

Revise the proposal while retaining novelty=field and the explicit unresolved obligation oeq:score-lifting-completeness.

1. Replace def:joint-model by an explicit local rank-chart construction. Fix a base law P and a dominated Hellinger neighborhood whose densities are locally uniformly equivalent to P; transport the varying L2 marginal spaces and T_a(P') to fixed Hilbert spaces by the canonical square-root-density isometries. Require norm-continuity of the transported operators, fixed nullity and cokernel dimension, closed range with a locally uniform positive reduced minimum modulus, and gap/operator-norm continuity of the kernel and cokernel projections. Define the outcome- and treatment-bridge solvability loci separately and define the joint chart as their intersection. Quantify admissible paths as every DQM/Hellinger differentiable t↦P_t lying in this chart, with sqrt(p_t)=sqrt(p)(1+t s/2)+o(t) in L2(nu), s∈L0²(P). Do not require a preselected differentiable bridge path. Treat treatment-bridge existence as a genuine solvability restriction. Do not call its general locus a submanifold unless proved; prove submanifold status only on the finite positive chart using the displayed constraint map and its constant/full-row-rank calculation. Keep the reverse inclusion T_P⊇C_P^perp as the open score-lifting problem.

2. Separate the observed statistical target from its causal interpretation. In the main model and tangent theorems call theta the observed joint-bridge functional. Add a causal-identification corollary under a latent extension with U and potential outcomes, consistency, latent exchangeability Y(a) ⟂ A | (U,X), latent positivity, the exact standard negative-control independences used (including Z outcome-negative-control and W treatment-negative-control conditions), and existence of at least one latent-compatible outcome bridge h_a^dagger satisfying E[h_a^dagger(W,X)|U,X]=E[Y(a)|U,X]. Show that h_a^dagger satisfies the observed bridge equation and that treatment-bridge existence makes every observed bridge representative have the same marginal mean, hence theta=E[Y(1)-Y(0)]. Do not add bridge uniqueness, surjectivity, injectivity, minimum-norm selection, or completeness merely to obtain the causal label. If latent compatibility is not maintained, consistently label theta an observed bridge functional rather than a causal ATE.

3. Replace the assumption ||hat psi-theta-phi_eff||_2=o_p(1) in thm:affine-ensemble-inference by primitive sufficient conditions and prove that convergence as a lemma. Introduce: (i) population bridge dictionaries and sieve approximation alpha_J→0; (ii) foldwise L2/L4 bridge-estimation and conditional-moment-residual rates for h_hat-h and q_hat-q, with a derived bound for the learned dictionary error; (iii) a nonzero-eigenvalue Gram bound kappa_J, empirical Gram/cross-moment perturbations small relative to kappa_J, rho_J=o(kappa_J), and an explicit ridge-bias rate; (iv) exact affine weight constraints sum_r lambda_ar=1 and an explicit total-variation/l1 envelope L_n controlling weight and dictionary errors; and (v) a primitive mixed-bias rate such as sqrt(n)L_n times the smaller of the outcome-residual×q-error and adjoint-residual×h-error products tending to zero, uniformly over retained representatives/folds. State moment/envelope and J_n growth conditions sufficient for the empirical Gram bounds. Derive prediction convergence of the fitted projection, then efficient-signal convergence, asymptotic linearity, and variance consistency. Do not assume oracle weights, oracle projector convergence, or the desired efficient-signal convergence under a renamed condition.

4. Add a separately labeled, assumption-matched direct comparison with Chen–Xie Theorem 3. Define their outcome-bridge-only local model in the same transported coordinates and verify, rather than assert, that the comparison law satisfies their hypotheses and that the target derivatives agree. If this verification succeeds, prove T_joint⊂T_CX and phi_eff,joint=Pi_{T_joint}(phi_eff,CX), V_CX-V_joint=||Pi_{T_CX∩T_joint^perp} phi_eff,CX||², identify the additional adjoint-solvability normal directions as the nonredundant parts of the G/R classes modulo the outcome-only normal space, and compute an exact strictly positive gap on the displayed finite chart. If P* does not satisfy Chen–Xie’s hypotheses, do not claim a strict comparison at P*: either construct a matched finite witness or state exact non-comparability and leave this as an explicit field-tier strengthening obligation. A prose statement that the models differ is insufficient, but neither model nesting nor strictness may be assumed.

Hard-kernel firewall: it is forbidden to assume that every element of C_P^perp is realizable by a path score; to define admissible paths using freely chosen differentiable bridge derivatives; to assume that the treatment-solvability locus has normal space exactly span(G,R); to impose completeness/uniqueness/surjectivity that collapses the nonunique fibers; or to assume nonzero Chen–Xie projection or learned efficient-signal convergence. Each of those would launder the central score-lifting or estimator kernel rather than solve it.

Make only the following D-1.2 repairs. Preserve novelty=field and keep oeq:score-lifting-completeness explicitly unresolved.

1. Retag ass:local-uniform-equivalence as a nonstandard “bounded likelihood-ratio chart” assumption; remove the vanDerVaart1998Asymptotic attribution. Do not describe {P′: c≤p′/p≤C} as a Hellinger-open neighborhood. Define it as a deliberately restricted chart domain and delimit the general theorem to that domain. Give two verifiable regimes: (i) a positive finite-support simplex restricted away from its boundary, including the displayed 36-cell chart; and (ii) a genuinely nonfinite example such as a bounded exponential-tilt family p_eta/p=exp{etaᵀg−psi(eta)} with bounded measurable g and eta in a sufficiently small compact neighborhood. State explicitly that generic dominated DQM models and paths with uncontrolled likelihood ratios are outside this version, and that score lifting must be proved relative to the actual bounded-ratio path class rather than presumed unchanged.

2. Delete ass:kernel-gap-continuity and ass:cokernel-gap-continuity as independent assumptions. Add an operator-perturbation lemma in the fixed transported Hilbert spaces: if A′→A in operator norm and the reduced minimum moduli of A and A′ are bounded below by mu>0, then gap(ker A′,ker A) ≤ ||A′−A||/mu and, applying the same argument to adjoints, gap(ker A′*,ker A*) ≤ ||A′−A||/mu, hence the associated orthogonal projections converge in operator norm. Use a conservative constant if required by the chosen gap convention. Fixed nullity/cokernel may remain as rank-chart labels, but acknowledge if the lemma makes them locally derivable once the gap is below one. Update every dependency to use this lemma. Do not infer differentiability of projections, differentiable bridge selections, solvability-submanifold structure, or T_P=C_P^perp from this continuity result.

3. Fully define the fold-specific estimator. For every fold k write b_hat^{(-k)}, D_hat^{(-k)}, and the training Gram/cross-moment explicitly. Enumerate, for each arm a, a base cell S_{a,00}, pure outcome columns D^h_{a,j}=t_a(S_{a,j0}−S_{a,00}), pure treatment columns D^q_{a,l}=t_a(S_{a,0l}−S_{a,00}), and four-corner columns D^{hq}_{a,jl}=t_a(S_{a,jl}−S_{a,j0}−S_{a,0l}+S_{a,00}). If b=(b^h,b^q,b^{hq}) and the fitted adjustment is −bᵀD, define the deterministic coefficient-to-weight map lambda_{a,jl}=−b^{hq}_{a,jl}, lambda_{a,j0}=−b^h_{a,j}+sum_l b^{hq}_{a,jl}, lambda_{a,0l}=−b^q_{a,l}+sum_j b^{hq}_{a,jl}, lambda_{a,00}=1+sum_j b^h_{a,j}+sum_l b^q_{a,l}−sum_{j,l}b^{hq}_{a,jl}. Verify algebraically that the weights sum to one and that their weighted cell signal equals the adjusted base signal. If weights are intended to depend on X, explicitly tensor the dictionary columns with a declared finite measurable basis of X and apply this map pointwise; otherwise remove “(X)” and use scalar weights.

Require each bridge learner and basis evaluation to be measurable with respect to the training sigma-field, use rho_n>0 to make each ridge coefficient unique, and make the coefficient-to-weight map deterministic and Borel. If an l1-envelope constraint is enforced through a quadratic program, state its nonempty feasible set (the base weight is feasible), existence, uniqueness or deterministic measurable tie-break. Define the held-out signal for i in I_k using only b_hat^{(-k)}, training-fitted bridges, and O_i, and state conditional training/holdout independence and square-integrability. Update the learned-projection lemma to use these fold-indexed objects.

Laundering firewall: do not call the bounded-ratio chart standard or claim it preserves the unrestricted Hellinger tangent set; do not use the perturbation lemma to assert path realization or tangent equality; and do not define affine weights existentially as weights that reproduce the efficient signal, use oracle coefficients, use held-out outcomes to choose weights, or introduce unrepresented X-dependent coefficients.
